subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation accept private-network authorization from both browser.ssrfPolicy and models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork, with all configured xAI request transport overrides applied through useConfiguredRequest?
rationale: Both inputs are established operator configuration, but enabling them on this provider intentionally changes an SSRF boundary and also activates the broader configured-request transport contract.

options.title: Approve both existing opt-ins
options.body: Keep the current shared-path implementation and require production-path proof for default denial and both explicit authorization modes.

options.title: Restrict to provider request policy
options.body: Remove the browser.ssrfPolicy override and authorize xAI image private-network access only through models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Retain fail-closed xAI image requests until maintainers define a different scoped private-endpoint policy.

recommendation.title: Approve both existing opt-ins
recommendation.body: Keep the current shared-path implementation and require production-path proof for default denial and both explicit authorization modes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged and live-validated the original xAI image provider and is the strongest available owner for its authorization boundary.
